SELECT p.product_id, p.member_id, p.category_id, p.title, p.description, p.condition, p.model_name, p.release_year, p.market_price, p.thumbnail_url, p.status as product_status, p.created_at as product_created_at, p.updated_at as product_updated_at, p.deleted_at as product_deleted_at,
a.auction_id, a.start_price, a.current_price, a.auction_time, a.started_at, a.ended_at, a.status as auction_status, a.bid_count, a.bidder_count, a.view_count, a.bookmark_count, a.top_bid_id, a.extension_count, a.created_at as auction_created_at, a.updated_at as auction_updated_at, a.deleted_at as auction_deleted_at, a.live_broadcast_id
FROM product p JOIN auction a ON p.product_id = a.product_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status IN ('REGISTERED', 'ON_AUCTION') AND p.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

SELECT p.product_id, p.title, p.description, p.condition, p.model_name, p.release_year, p.market_price, p.thumbnail_url, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.moderation_reason, p.moderation_stage, p.moderated_at,
c.category_id, c.name AS category_name,
m.member_id, m.nickname, m.profile_image_url
FROM product p JOIN category c ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN member m ON m.member_id = p.member_id WHERE p.product_id = #{productId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT p.product_id, p.member_id, m.nickname AS member_nickname, p.title, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.moderation_reason, p.moderation_stage, p.moderated_at FROM product p JOIN member m ON m.member_id = p.member_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
AND p.status = #{status}::product_status
AND p.status IN ('PENDING'::product_status, 'REJECTED'::product_status)
ORDER BY p.created_at
